claims.statement: The assignment overview is described as showing acceptances and student progress; the linked procedure remains separate. Overview availability does not prove complete population, meaningful progress, valid grades or current post-sunset service capability.

For an accepted assignment configured with an IDE, the generated README contains a top button linking to the IDE workspace. A link's presence is not verified workspace provisioning, authentication, execution, safety or zero cost.

Existing assignments may be reused in another classroom only with admin access, including across organizations. Cross-organization reuse is conditional on authority; it does not automatically clear template rights, transfer student records or authorize changes. The linked reuse procedure remains separate.
The sign-in step identifies the templated Classroom service. A login instruction neither grants credentials nor proves authentication, permissions or current availability; no sign-in was attempted.

The source names LTI 1.3 and LTI Advantage for LMS connections and attributes certification to IMS Global; those upstream assertions are not independent security assurance. It lists tested registration/connection/roster import for Blackboard (community supported), Canvas, Moodle, Sakai and Google Classroom. Other LTI 1.3 systems may work but are unverified and may need admin privacy/button settings and launch documentation. The independently reviewed included Google note qualifies the list: Google Classroom is non-LTI and does not require preceding LTI connection. No live integrations, certification documents or student import were verified.
The Update assignment click is a contextual save action, not proof of persisted settings, successful mutation, approval or currently supported post-sunset workflow.
